# add adobe-acrobat-reader

Add the `adobe-acrobat-reader` cask — Adobe Acrobat Reader DC, for PDFs that Preview does not handle (forms, signatures) — to the Homebrew toolset. The original reference is the [cask page](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/adobe-acrobat-reader).
